mapper.select: SELECT connected_id FROM `user` WHERE id = #{userId} AND connected_id IS NOT NULL AND connected_id != '' LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO account (user_id, company, number, card_name, account_id, account_password, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{company}, #{number}, #{cardName}, #{accountId}, #{accountPassword}, NOW())

INSERT INTO card (user_id, card_product_id, company, number, card_name, card_id, card_password, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{cardProductId}, #{company}, #{number}, #{cardName}, #{cardId}, #{cardPassword}, NOW())

INSERT INTO account_record (account_id, type, category, title, amount, record_date, memo, created_at) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{type}, #{category}, #{title}, #{amount}, STR_TO_DATE(#{recordDate}, '%Y-%m-%d'), #{memo}, NOW())

INSERT INTO card_record (card_id, type, category, title, amount, record_date, memo, created_at) VALUES (#{cardId}, #{type}, #{category}, #{title}, #{amount}, STR_TO_DATE(#{recordDate}, '%Y-%m-%d'), #{memo}, NOW())
